test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Recycling is a key component of modern waste reduction and is the third component of the ‘Reduce, Reuse and Recycle’ waste hierarchy _______ aim is to extract the maximum practical benefits from products and to generate the minimum amount of waste.
solution:
The correct answer is '**whose**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**whose**'.
 
• The word "**whose**" is **a pronoun **used to show possession.
